summary: Frontend-only UI validation of the Memoraq Expo web preview. 21/27 UI checks passed, including Onboarding flow (Skip + Continue), Customers empty state, filter chips, Search tab, Follow Ups bucket chips, Settings screen, Pro screen with 'Unlock Memoraq Pro' flipping entitlement to a confirmed state, and Privacy screen with support email isahsileem@gmail.com. 3 real issues found, all stemming from the same root cause: on web preview expo-sqlite OPFS is unavailable and several screens/actions call the DB WITHOUT the withTimeout wrapper used elsewhere, so they hang forever instead of degrading to an empty/graceful state. Affected: Follow Ups tab stuck in 'Loading…' (never falls back to 'Nothing scheduled'), Settings → Load Sample Data silently hangs (no toast within 5s), Add Customer paste import stuck on 'Parsing transcript…' which blocks Customer detail testing on web. Also one false-negative on the first Pro-unlock assertion (success state 'You are on Memoraq Pro' did render — issue was only with the regex in my first test; verified in follow-up screenshot). No deprecated expo-* packages detected, no SafeAreaView misuse, no React Native red screen errors.

ui_bugs.issue: `load()` awaits `listFollowUps(bucket)` directly without the `withTimeout` wrapper used in customers.tsx. On web preview (expo-sqlite OPFS unavailable) `items` stays `null` and screen is permanently stuck on 'Loading…', never showing the 'Nothing scheduled' empty state. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/followups.tsx:28-36

`onLoadSample` awaits `loadSampleData()` with no timeout. On web preview the call hangs; toast ('Loaded N sample customers' or 'Sample data already present or app not empty') never appears. User gets no feedback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:62-66 and /app/frontend/src/platform/sample-data.ts

`importPasted` -> `runImport({kind:'text',...})` hangs indefinitely on web preview. Status remains 'Parsing transcript…' and `open-imported-customer` button never renders, blocking the full add-customer / customer-detail test path. Needs withTimeout / graceful web fallback inside the import pipeline. Reference: /app/frontend/app/customer/add.tsx:51-56 and /app/frontend/src/importer/import-pipeline.ts

integration_issues.flow: Paste transcript → create customer → open detail
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be verified on web preview because the paste-import step never resolves. All downstream testIDs (open-imported-customer, customer-detail-screen, detail-tab-*) are unreachable from the web preview. Needs either a web fallback in the import pipeline, or an in-memory DB shim for web.

action_items: Wrap `listFollowUps`/`getCustomer` loop in followups.tsx with the existing `withTimeout` helper (default to [] after ~1.5s) so Follow Ups falls back to the 'Nothing scheduled' empty state on web, matching customers.tsx behavior.

Wrap `loadSampleData()` in settings.tsx with a timeout (or make the function itself detect missing SQLite on web and return 0 quickly) so the toast always fires. Current UX silently hangs on web preview.

Harden the import pipeline (src/importer/import-pipeline.ts): detect when SQLite is unavailable on web and either (a) persist to a web/in-memory shim or (b) surface a clear 'Not supported on web preview' error so the paste/import flow stops hanging on 'Parsing transcript…'.
Consider surfacing a single app-wide 'Running without local storage (web preview)' banner so testers know why DB-backed features degrade.
critical_code_review_comments: Inconsistent use of the withTimeout DB wrapper: customers.tsx uses it, but followups.tsx, settings.tsx (load sample), and the import pipeline do not. Centralize this.

Follow Ups screen initial state uses `null` to mean 'loading' with no error path — if the awaited call never resolves there is no way to recover. Add a `setItems([])` in a catch and in a timeout branch.
Settings → Load Sample Data provides no UI loading indicator while awaiting; combined with the hang this looks like a dead button on web.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://customer-memory-dev.preview.emergentagent.com. Set localStorage key 'memoraq.onboarded'='1' and reload to skip onboarding. Mobile viewport 390x844. All tested testIDs match /app/memory/test_credentials.md. On web preview, expo-sqlite OPFS is unavailable; screens that use the `withTimeout` helper degrade gracefully, screens that don't will hang on 'Loading…'. After fixes, re-verify: (1) Follow Ups shows 'Nothing scheduled' empty state within ~2s, (2) Settings → Load Sample Data produces a toast within ~2s, (3) Add Customer paste flow with sample '12/08/23, 10:30 AM - Rahul: Hi\n12/08/23, 10:31 AM - You: Hello' surfaces open-imported-customer, which then opens customer-detail-screen with tabs conversation/notes/attachments/activity.
rca_of_issue: Root cause for all three HIGH bugs is identical: expo-sqlite's OPFS web backend is not available in the Emergent web preview, so any `await` against the DB layer never resolves. The app partially handles this via `withTimeout(call, 1500, fallback)` in src/db/schema.ts and uses it correctly in app/(tabs)/customers.tsx. However, Follow Ups, Load Sample Data, and the paste-import pipeline call DB functions directly. Reproduction: open the preview URL on web, set `memoraq.onboarded='1'`, reload. Follow Ups tab stays on 'Loading…' indefinitely; Settings → Load Sample Data shows no toast; Add Customer with any pasted text stays on 'Parsing transcript…'. Mitigation: wrap the DB-dependent awaits in `withTimeout` with sensible fallbacks (empty array / 0 / clear error), or detect `Platform.OS === 'web'` + missing OPFS once in src/db/schema.ts and short-circuit all repo calls with the empty results instead of hanging.
